candidate_record.nl_statement: Suppose a, b, c, and d are integers and n is a positive integer. If a is congruent to b modulo n and c is congruent to d modulo n, then a + c is congruent to b + d modulo n.
candidate_record.difficulty_rationale: One congruence-preserving operation using two hypotheses; provisional rating pending rubric calibration.
candidate_record.expected_lean_statement: theorem modEq_add_two (a b c d n : ℤ) (_hn : 0 < n) (hab : a ≡ b [ZMOD n]) (hcd : c ≡ d [ZMOD n]) : a + c ≡ b + d [ZMOD n]
candidate_record.source_location: Section 5.2, “Congruence and Arithmetic,” printed page 314; PDF parser page 328.
